lines.1: Even after getting off, a faint floating sensation lingered.
lines.2: 「You're awfully quiet, Konoe. Were you scared?」
lines.3: 「I just don't want to talk to you!」
lines.5: Whoa. If I argued back, we'd start fighting again.
lines.6: I would hold it in this time.
lines.9: 「I went to get you tickets for this.」
lines.12: 'A dreamlike time for you. Hakkeijima Observation Tower, yours alone for fifteen minutes.'
lines.13: 「You'll have the whole observation tower to yourselves. Impressive, isn't it?」
lines.14: 「Use the time to meet each other halfway and make up.」
lines.16: 「Fifteen minutes alone with Tsushima? That's a little much...」
lines.18: Otome firmly dragged both Konoe and me along.
lines.19: 「I'll wait at that shop over there with some matcha and rice balls. Come find me when you're done.」
lines.24: What was so dreamlike about this?
lines.25: It felt like sitting on a bed of nails...
lines.29: Neither of us said a word.
lines.30: The tower slowly began to rise.
lines.31: The view from the top would probably be spectacular.
lines.32: Normally, this would be a fun ride.
lines.34: Why did I have to be alone with her of all people!?
lines.35: I'd have more fun hanging out alone with Fukahire.
lines.36: I wondered what he was doing right now.
